description: Stožáry veřejného osvětlení is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statutární město Most. Point data set of public lighting masts on the territory of the city of Most. The attribute TYPPORIZ (Type of acquisition) describes the method of data acquisition. It takes values 1 (= GZ - geodetic focus) and 2 (= plot). Coverage: Statutární město Most. The portal shows the English title as "Public lighting poles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statutární město Most. Its keywords include lampa, veřejné osvětlení, stožár, osvětlení, pouliční osvětlení. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, HTML, ZIP, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00266094/d1d2918299ad3c906f31caed3faffdbd/distribuce/550d0a278df883f564ba8265f484b31f/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
